description: This source file implements a Bluetooth chat service for managing Bluetooth connections, including establishing, maintaining, and data transmission between devices in an Android application.

classes.name: BluetoothChatService
classes.description: Main class managing Bluetooth connections, including listening for incoming connections, initiating outgoing connections, and handling data transfer via dedicated threads.

methods.name: BluetoothChatService
methods.description: Constructor initializing BluetoothAdapter and handler, setting initial state.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the current connection state and notifies UI via handler.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming connections by launching AcceptThreads and resets ongoing connection threads.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to a specified Bluetooth device, choosing secure or insecure connection type.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles post-connection setup, starts data transmission thread, and notifies UI of connected device.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all connection and listening threads, resetting state to none.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the connected device via the Bluetooth socket.

methods.name: connectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failed connection attempts, notifies UI, and restarts listening.

methods.name: connectionLost
methods.description: Handles lost connection events, notifies UI, and restarts listening.
